recs.x:
One of my favorite quotes: "A scientist builds in order to learn. An engineer learns in order to build."

[0] [link]

read, especially for me -- I have a tendency to get hung up on the cool tools and fun methods in programming, which is OK in hobby environments, but if the purpose of the software is to solve a problem, you need to keep an eye on the problem. The book extends this insight to managerial methods, famously, and to me feels akin to Goodhart's law, about how once a metric becomes a target, it ceases to be a useful metric.

There's a great interview with Frederick Brooks on Youtube, not specifically about the System/360, but the guy was amazingly self-aware: [link]
